title: "Installing AI CLI Tools"

## Choose Your Tool

All these CLI tools let you work with AI directly in your terminal. Pick one to start - they all work similarly.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Recommendation
**Claude Code** is what we use in this course. But the skills transfer to any of these tools.
:::

| Tool | Provider | Model | Pricing |
|------|----------|-------|---------|
| **Claude Code** | Anthropic | Claude | Claude Pro/Max ($20+/mo) or Console |
| **Codex CLI** | OpenAI | GPT models | ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) or higher |
| **Copilot CLI** | GitHub | Multiple (Claude, GPT); on Free and Student plans Copilot picks the model | Copilot (~$10/mo, **free for students/teachers**) |
| **Antigravity CLI** | Google | Gemini | Free tier + Google AI Pro |


---

## Prerequisites (All Tools)

Before installing any CLI tool, you need:

### 1. Node.js

You only need Node.js if you install a tool with `npm` (Copilot CLI via npm needs Node.js 22 or later). The recommended installers below do not need it. Check if you have it:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows
```
node --version
```
If not installed: Download from [nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/) (LTS version)

### Mac
```
node --version
```
If not installed:
```
brew install node
```
Or download from [nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/)

### Linux
```
node --version
```
If not installed:
```
# Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt update && sudo apt install nodejs npm

# Fedora
sudo dnf install nodejs npm
```

:::

### 2. A Terminal

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows
- **Windows Terminal** (recommended) - comes with Windows 11, or install from Microsoft Store
- **PowerShell** - built-in, search "PowerShell"
- **Command Prompt** - built-in, search "cmd"

### Mac
- **Terminal** - built-in, press `Cmd+Space`, type "Terminal"
- **iTerm2** - popular alternative

### Linux
- Usually `Ctrl+Alt+T` or search "Terminal"

:::

::: {.callout-note}
## VS Code Users
You can also open a terminal directly inside VS Code! Press `` Ctrl+` `` (backtick) on Windows/Linux or `` Cmd+` `` on Mac—or go to **View → Terminal**. This keeps everything in one window.
:::

**New to the terminal?** Read [Terminal Basics](terminal-basics.html) first.

## Claude Code

Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.

### What is Claude Code?

Claude Code is a command-line tool that lets you work with Claude directly in your terminal. It can read, edit, and create files, run commands, and help with coding and data analysis where your code lives.

**Why use it?**

- Works directly with your files and folders
- Can read, edit, and create code for you
- Runs commands and sees the output
- Great for data analysis workflows
- No copy-pasting between browser and code editor

### Install

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows

PowerShell:
```
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

Command Prompt:
```
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd
```

### Mac

```
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```

Or with Homebrew:
```
brew install --cask claude-code
```

### Linux

```
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```

:::

### Use

Navigate to your project folder and start:
```
cd /path/to/your/project
claude
```

**First time**: You'll be prompted to log in via browser. You need one of:
- **Claude Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, or Enterprise** subscription (recommended; the free plan does not include Claude Code)
- **Claude Console** account (API access with pre-paid credits)

**After login**: Type your requests naturally like "what does this project do?" or "add a hello world function to the main file."

**More details:** [Claude Code Documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/quickstart)

### Quick Tips

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `claude` | Start Claude Code |
| `exit` | Quit Claude Code |
| `claude --help` | See all options |
| `/help` | Get help while inside Claude |

### Requirements

- **Claude account** — Sign up at [claude.ai](https://claude.ai) if you don't have one
- **Subscription or Console credits** — Claude Pro/Max/Ultra/Team/Enterprise or a Claude Console account with credits
- **Internet connection** — Claude runs in the cloud

### Troubleshooting

- **"command not found"** — Close and reopen your terminal, then try again
- **"Permission denied"** — Re-run the install step with admin permissions or follow the OS-specific instructions above
- **"Authentication failed"** — Make sure your Claude subscription/credits are active and try logging in again

## Antigravity CLI

Google's terminal agent for Gemini models. It replaced Gemini CLI for individual users in June 2026.

### Install

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows

PowerShell:
```
irm https://antigravity.google/cli/install.ps1 | iex
```

### Mac

```
curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash
```

### Linux

```
curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash
```

:::

### Use

Navigate to your project folder and start:
```
cd /path/to/your/project
agy
```

**First time**: You'll be prompted to sign in with your Google account. There is a free tier; Google AI Pro raises the limits.

**More details:** [Antigravity CLI Documentation](https://antigravity.google/docs/install?tab=cli)

---

## Codex CLI

OpenAI's command-line coding tool.

### Install

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows

PowerShell:
```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.ps1 | iex"
```

Or with npm:
```
npm install -g @openai/codex
```

### Mac

```
curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh
```

Or: `npm install -g @openai/codex` / `brew install openai/tap/codex`

### Linux

```
curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh
```

Or with npm:
```
npm install -g @openai/codex
```

:::

### Use

Navigate to your project folder and start:
```
cd /path/to/your/project
codex
```

**First time**: You'll be prompted to sign in via browser. You can authenticate with:

- **ChatGPT account** (Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise) - recommended
- **OpenAI API key** (alternative option)

**More details:** [Codex CLI Documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/codex/cli)

---

## GitHub Copilot CLI

GitHub's terminal coding agent — the same agent that powers Copilot in VS Code. **Free for verified students and teachers** via the [GitHub Student Developer Pack](https://education.github.com/pack).

### Install

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows

```
winget install GitHub.Copilot
```

Or with npm (needs Node.js 22+):
```
npm install -g @github/copilot
```

On Windows, Copilot CLI needs PowerShell 6 or later (Windows ships with 5.1).

### Mac

```
brew install --cask copilot-cli
```

Or with npm (needs Node.js 22+):
```
npm install -g @github/copilot
```

### Linux

```
npm install -g @github/copilot
```

:::

### Use

Navigate to your project folder and start:
```
cd /path/to/your/project
copilot
```

**First time**: You'll be prompted to sign in via browser with the GitHub account that has your Copilot access.

**More details:** [Copilot CLI Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-cli)
